mermaid:
flowchart LR
    S["Shopper in a chat product"] --> A["Agent"]
    A -->|"reads feed and catalog"| F["Merchant product feed"]
    A -->|"shape 1 hand off"| C1["Merchant's own checkout"]
    A -->|"shape 2 cart and pay"| C2["Checkout inside the channel"]
    C2 -->|"payment token"| P["PSP and card network"]
    C1 --> O["Order record"]
    C2 --> O
    A -->|"where is my order"| O

flowchart TB
    I["Identity layer: Web Bot Auth signatures, agent profiles, Visa TAP, Mastercard Agent Pay"] --> C["Commerce layer: UCP or ACP define feed, cart, checkout, order"]
    C --> T["Transport layer: MCP, REST, JSON-RPC, A2A"]
    C --> P["Payment layer: AP2 mandates, scoped payment tokens, network agent tokens"]
    P --> SCA["In the EU the shopper still authenticates the exact cart"]

sequenceDiagram
    participant Sh as Shopper
    participant Ag as Agent
    participant Me as Merchant gateway
    participant Av as Availability and promise
    participant PSP as PSP and issuer
    participant OMS as OMS
    Sh->>Ag: Find a Ridgewalker women's M moss under 200 euro by Thursday
    Ag->>Me: Search catalog and build cart
    Me->>Av: Can this be promised for Thursday
    Av-->>Me: Yes, one unit allocatable, delivery Thursday
    Me-->>Ag: Final cart 199 euro, delivery Thursday, free returns 14 days
    Ag->>Sh: Approve this exact cart
    Sh->>PSP: Passkey authentication bound to 199 euro and the merchant
    PSP-->>Me: Authorized
    Me->>OMS: Create order, channel agent, agent id recorded
    OMS-->>Ag: Order number and status endpoint

flowchart LR
    CH1["Chat product A"] --> AD1["UCP adapter"]
    CH2["Chat product B"] --> AD2["ACP adapter"]
    CH3["Service bot and storefront"] --> API["One internal commerce API"]
    AD1 --> API
    AD2 --> API
    API --> PIM["PIM: product and policy"]
    API --> AV["Availability and promise"]
    API --> OMS["OMS: cart, order, status"]
    ID["Agent identity at the edge"] --> AD1
    ID --> AD2
